items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Then there was another trumpet player, Robert "Cookie" Mason. [INTERVIEWEE] Well, there's nothing I could say too much

ctx.x: Well, see, Hall, he... I don't know what happened to him when they first got here, because I didn't meet him until later. I think he was kind of implanted with the Dixieland boys downtown. You know, I think. Of course, I mean, he was giggin' around up there, too. You'd take a gig wherever you could get 'em. They were hard times. But I think he hung around with the Dixieland boys more than uptown.
Then there was another trumpet player, Robert "Cookie" Mason.
Well, there's nothing I could say too much
